C_rfanm_vale.name: Commander Edda Vale
C_rfanm_vale.role: senior Rex Fleet navigator and Academy instructor whose Mirrorfold case logs form the spine of the course
C_rfanm_vale.voice: precise, patient, dry; asks questions before giving answers and distinguishes certainty from confidence
C_rfanm_vale.visual: early-50s woman with silver threaded through close-cropped dark hair, strong nose, weathered olive skin, steady dark eyes, lean build; mature Fleet navigation uniform in deep blue, Ion White and restrained gold, with practical instructor tabs rather than ceremonial decoration

C_rfanm_marin.name: Lio Marin
C_rfanm_marin.role: pilot-track cadet with excellent spatial instincts who initially trusts visual geometry too quickly
C_rfanm_marin.voice: quick, confident and curious; jokes under pressure but accepts correction when evidence is concrete
C_rfanm_marin.visual: early-20s lean male cadet with warm brown skin, short black curls, expressive brows and an athletic pilot's posture; Academy training uniform in Ion White and Fleet blue with a narrow gold shoulder stripe

C_rfanm_rook.name: Tamsin Rook
C_rfanm_rook.role: navigation-track cadet who trusts instrumentation and computation until the Mirrorfold teaches her to question sensor provenance
C_rfanm_rook.voice: measured, technical and exact; dislikes hand-waving and states assumptions aloud
C_rfanm_rook.visual: early-20s tall female cadet with pale freckled skin, straight auburn hair cut to the jaw, gray-green eyes and a composed posture; Academy training uniform with a compact navigation slate worn at the hip

C_rfanm_orin.name: Hale Orin
C_rfanm_orin.role: systems-track cadet who notices latency, signal path and instrument dependencies before the others
C_rfanm_orin.voice: quiet, concrete and observant; speaks when he has a specific discrepancy to point to
C_rfanm_orin.visual: early-20s compact male cadet with dark skin, shaved head, rectangular field optics and careful hands; Academy uniform with a small systems-tool roll and sensor interface cuff

C_rfanm_kess.name: Nadi Kess
C_rfanm_kess.role: junior-command cadet responsible for choosing among imperfect recommendations during simulations
C_rfanm_kess.voice: calm, direct and operational; repeats the decision she believes she is actually making before committing
C_rfanm_kess.visual: mid-20s female cadet with medium-brown skin, long black hair braided tightly back, broad shoulders and a calm watchful expression; Academy command-track uniform with a white collar tab and minimal gold

C_rfanm_pell.name: Joren Pell
C_rfanm_pell.role: survey pilot and mission lead aboard RFV Far Lantern in Vale's formative Mirrorfold case
C_rfanm_pell.voice: experienced, practical and skeptical without being dismissive; wants a flyable instruction, not a theory
C_rfanm_pell.visual: late-30s broad-shouldered man with tawny skin, shaved sides with dark hair on top, short beard and tired blue-gray eyes; survey-flight uniform worn soft at the seams, blue and white with muted gold rank marks

C_rfanm_iri.name: Sana Iri
C_rfanm_iri.role: systems technician aboard RFV Far Lantern who disentangles reflected signal paths during the rescue case
C_rfanm_iri.voice: practical, fast and lightly sardonic; translates abstract sensor behavior into things the bridge can act on
C_rfanm_iri.visual: early-30s woman with copper-brown skin, short dense curls, a square face and alert amber-brown eyes; survey systems coverall in Fleet blue with white utility panels, resonance tools clipped at the waist

C_rfanm_researcher_a.name: Dr. Eren Vos
C_rfanm_researcher_a.role: Mirrorfold field researcher rescued from survey pod Mica-7
C_rfanm_researcher_a.voice: controlled but strained after the pod accident
C_rfanm_researcher_a.visual: 40s researcher with dark blond hair, narrow face and a light field suit scuffed by impact

C_rfanm_researcher_b.name: Dr. Mina Saye
C_rfanm_researcher_b.role: Mirrorfold field researcher rescued from survey pod Mica-7
C_rfanm_researcher_b.voice: concise and focused on the practical condition of the pod
C_rfanm_researcher_b.visual: 30s researcher with black hair in a low knot, brown skin and a light field suit with a cracked shoulder plate
